description: Ramanujan A0.5a inheritance manifest. Pins each INHERITED module/artifact Ramanujan composes (it never reimplements them, per NS8) to a resolvable path + an expected interface SHAPE + a version signal. The Wave-2 gate (src/inherits-gate.mjs) reads this, resolves every entry, version-checks it, interface-shape-checks it, and round-trips a durable counter/spent-nonce through the durability-substrate entry. Any unresolvable path / version mismatch / interface mismatch fails the gate fast (non-zero), naming the offending logical_name. Paths are resolved RELATIVE TO THIS FILE (repo root); the inherited repos are siblings of this build under <path>.
inheritance_set: Phase-0 (handoff/journal/sleep + the atomic durability substrate they build on) | Gandalf v1 commission seam | the three research dive engines (dive-1/dive-2/dive-3)

entries.note: The atomic write-tmp+fsync+rename / validating-read substrate that Phase-0 (handoff/journal/sleep) and the Crucible/researchPrime engines all persist through. This is the inherited 'Phase-0 durability substrate' the P9 contract names; Wave 4's monotone counter / spent-nonce set reuses it (no new store). The Wave-2 gate round-trips a counter/spent value through these exports across a simulated reload.

Gandalf v1 SITUATE compose seam: mints the typed commission ENVELOPE (commissionResearchPrime) Ramanujan's CONTEXTUALIZE pillar emits (never dispatches inline). No package.json / version export upstream, so no semver is pinned; path + interface shape are.
Dive-1 research engine deliverable (UNDERSTAND + firewall). A machine artifact, not a code module, so the interface SHAPE is its required top-level keys.
Dive-2 research engine deliverable (SOLVE + the verification stack).
Dive-3 research engine deliverable (INTERACTIVE PARTNER LAYER) — the layer that composes dive-1/dive-2/Gandalf/Phase-0 into the six-pillar partner.
